name: fix-add
prompt: Fix the add(a, b) function in add.mjs so it returns the sum of its arguments. Keep the named export. Edit the file, then verify your fix. Do not add dependencies.

argv: import assert from 'node:assert/strict'; import { add } from './add.mjs'; assert.equal(add(2, 3), 5); assert.equal(add(-2, 1), -1); assert.equal(add(0, 0), 0);
